SELECT AVG(l.amount) 
FROM loan l 
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id 
WHERE l.status IN ('C', 'D') AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 
    FROM trans t 
    WHERE t.account_id = a.account_id 
    AND t.type = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'
)
